surviving_definition.state_definition: encoded brightness Y_t(p) < 0.65 * same-frame fixed-support whole-stone median G_t
surviving_definition.primitive: adjacent-pair bright/dark state switch on pixels supported on both sides
surviving_definition.primary_scalar: sum switched pixel-pairs / sum eligible pixel-pairs over the exact 17-frame core

summary_candidates.role: trace/QC retained; primary scalar not promoted because core-to-wide rank persistence is weak
candidate/QC only because support choice materially changes the answer
not primary; too tied/quantized in 16-pair core
diagnostic only; still grows with observation opportunity

threshold_disposition.k_0_65: KEEP as the fixed operational baseline inherited from #27, not a calibrated truth
threshold_disposition.k_0_60_and_0_70: KEEP as mandatory sensitivity probes only; no per-stone/region tuning

window_diagnostics.normalized_rate_behavior: does not mechanically increase with the wider window; wider-window rates usually fall because additional poses are less active

redundancy_with_occupancy.disposition: KEEP switching as complementary temporal trace, but do not treat its scalar ranking as an independent quality axis

bidirectional_churn_share.definition: share of pair switching not explained by absolute net occupancy change; represents opposing bright-to-dark and dark-to-bright changes that cancel in occupancy

redundancy_with_occupancy.interpretation: occupancy measures amount dark; switching measures adjacent-step spatial reconfiguration

decisions.reason: Threshold ordering is stable, but core-to-wide cross-stone rank rho is only 0.4.
Window rank rho 0.8, perfect threshold rank stability, complete fixed support, and pair-local gives the same rate.
Window rank rho 0.8, perfect threshold rank stability, and fixed/pair-local disagreement is negligible.
Persistent support can fall below 0.20 and fixed/pair-local disagreement reaches about 0.046.
Reject as a separate primary definition: centre/inner are identical to fixed and middle is effectively duplicated; retain as QC.
Useful support-sensitivity QC, but not a stable primary outer descriptor.
Semantic geometry can be unavailable, collapse persistent support, or materially change pair traces; keep as localisation/QC experiment.
Retain as a secondary active-tail diagnostic; core-to-wide rank persistence is stronger than the regional centre rate and strong in inner/middle.
Too many ties at zero/one switch per core interval to serve as a useful primary scalar.
Despite normalized per-pixel rates underneath, the any-switch indicator still increases with observation opportunity and therefore remains window-length sensitive.

limitations: Four stones only; no population quality threshold is inferred.
Source steps are ordinal observations, not seconds or calibrated degrees.
Registered pixels are image coordinates, not tracked physical facets.
Switching is recorded-image behavior, not sparkle frequency, leakage, fire, calibrated light return, facet identity or cut quality.
Cross-stone values are comparable only under the same declared source-step window and measurement contract.
